requirement: Desktop first-run: the interface language follows the computer's, a saved pick wins, an unoffered one falls back to English with a line

oracle.invariant: __DSH_LOCALE__ answers the OS languages; with no pick preference is null, with the tracy_lang cookie the pick is handed back so the device never overrides it. A device language Tracy offers (de-AT) gives no line; an unoffered one (ja-JP) names it in its own language and the language used instead; a saved pick gives no line.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: no pick: the OS languages, preference null
a pick stands: it is handed back as the preference
the product page gets the OS languages, most preferred first
the device language is offered (vi-VN, de-AT, zh-Hans-CN): no line
not offered (ja-JP): the line names it in its own language
a saved pick: no line, whatever the device says
